title: Machi Koro-style round category icon spec
purpose: Small circular shop-category badge placed immediately before a Machi Koro-style card title.

integration_context.target_use: Generate only the icon asset for card compositing.
integration_context.composition: one centered circular badge filling most of the square canvas

icon_color.description: Dark green sampled from the unobstructed footer of backgrounds/green.png.

subject.default: small shop stall seen directly from the front
subject.description: A white silhouette resembling the classic Machi Koro shop category symbol.

pictogram.subject: small shop stall seen directly from the front
pictogram.description: A bold white silhouette of a tiny storefront or market stall: shallow peaked or flat roof cap, striped awning expressed only through chunky cut-in separations, two simple vertical supports, and a broad counter opening. Direct frontal view, symmetric, iconic, and readable at tiny size.
pictogram.shape_language: very simple, chunky, geometric, slightly rounded
pictogram.line_rule: Solid white silhouette with only a few broad negative-space separations; no thin line art.

visual_style.core: Flat two-color Machi Koro category badge.
visual_style.small_size_priority: instantly recognizable beside a card title

anti_patterns: do not omit the dark-green round badge
do not add an outer ring
do not use gradients, highlights, bevels, texture, or shadows
do not add letters, numbers, logos, or any text
do not add card furniture or scenery
do not use thin or intricate strokes

current_icon.subject: front-facing small shop stall silhouette
current_icon.expected_result: A dark-green solid circle with a simple bold white front-facing shop-stall pictogram on transparent canvas.

final_prompt_summary: Generate only a small Machi Koro-style category badge on a genuinely transparent square canvas. Make one perfect solid circle in #1E4321 filling about 85% of the canvas. Center a bold pure-white silhouette of a small shop stall viewed directly from the front: a shallow roof cap, a chunky striped awning represented by a few broad separations, two simple supports, and one broad counter opening. The stall pictogram should fill about 54% of the circle and resemble the classic shop-category silhouette without copying any branding. Flat two-color vector-style artwork only: no border, text, letters, numbers, logo, shading, gradient, texture, shadow, 3D effect, or background.
